description:
Georeference a scanned map image using pre-existing Ground Control Points (GCPs).

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Open the Georeferencer tool (Layer > Georeferencer or Raster > Georeferencer).
3. Open the raster file located at /home/ga/GIS_Data/historical_map.png.
4. Load the saved GCP points file from /home/ga/GIS_Data/historical_map.png.points (File > Load GCP Points).
5. Configure the Transformation Settings (Settings > Transformation Settings):
   - Transformation type: Polynomial 1 (Affine) or Helmert
   - Resampling method: Nearest Neighbour
   - Target CRS: EPSG:4326 (WGS 84)
   - Output raster: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/historical_map_georeferenced.tif
   - Ensure 'Load in QGIS when done' is checked (optional but good for verification).
6. Start Georeferencing (File > Start Georeferencing or Play button).
7. Close the Georeferencer window once complete.
